dedupe_keys.name: pradhan mantri fasal bima yojana pmfby crop insurance portal reports and dashboard including the weather based crop insurance scheme india

description: The national portal of India's crop insurance schemes, the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) and the Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (WBCIS), run by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare. The portal, read on 26 September 2026 after rendering, offers farmer enrolment, a premium calculator, application status, the Krishi Rakshak Portal and Helpline for grievances and crop loss reports, Reports and a graphical Dashboard, operational guidelines (2023), directories of insurers and bank branches, and links to apps including YES-TECH (yield estimation with technology), the CCE app for crop cutting experiments, the Crop Loss Assessment Platform and WINDS (Weather Information Network). A Climateverse India record (CC0, 2025) describes WBCIS as paying farmers on weather triggers from reference or backup weather stations, and says the dashboard shows eligible districts, applications, area and sum insured and premium collected. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC0-1.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: figures are shown through a dashboard, not bulk files. For simulation it gives insured area, premiums and claims for agriculture risk transfer after droughts, floods and weather shocks. A related catalogue record is the USDA RMA cause of loss data.
